questions.question: Expanded form of the term LIBOR is: ________.
questions.solution:
The expanded form of the term LIBOR is: London Inter-Bank Offered Rate.

 
• The average interest rate roughly calculated by leading banks in London which they would pay if they borrow from other banks is called as LIBOR.
 
• It was earlier known as BBA Libor whose full form was British Bankers' Association Libor.
 
• These rates are calculated for five currencies and published every day by Thomson Reuters.

questions.question: Who holds the post of Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission?

options.text: an ofﬁcial who holds the rank of a Cabinet Minister

questions.solution:
An ofﬁcial who holds the rank of a Cabinet Minister holds the post of Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission.

 
• The Planning commission was set up in March 1950 by a Resolution of Government of India.
 
• It makes an assessment and balanced utilization of all resources of the country.
 
• The Prime Minister is the ex- officio Chairman of the Planning Commission.
 
• Montek Singh Ahluwalia, was the last deputy chairman of the commission, resigned on May 26, 2014.

questions.question: Which of the following tax was initiated by the Alauddin Khilji?
questions.solution:
• Ghari was initiated by the Alauddin Khilji. Ghari was a house tax which was imposed by him on the people of his reign.
 
• Kharaj was a tax imposed by Firozshah Tughlaq on total production of lands which belonged to Non - Muslims.
 
• Zakat was a religious tax which was imposed on Muslims.
 
• In Kankut, the entire land was measured by pacing it and the crops were roughly calculated by inspection.

questions.question: Which of the following hills is situated in the southernmost part of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Cardamom Hills__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cardamom hills- Cardamom hills are in the state of Tamil Nadu.

 
 
• The highest peak of the cardamom hills is Anai Mudi.
 
• These hills are adjacent to Kanyakumari.
 
• It is widespread in the states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
 
• These hills are famous for the production of good tea and cardamom.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Nilgiri Hills are situated in Tamil Nadu.__

 
 
• Doddabetta is the highest peak of the Nilgiri hills.
 
• Nilgiri hills are a part of the Western Ghats.
 
• The hills are located at the tri-junction of the states Karnataka, Kerela, and Tamil Nadu.
 
• These mountains are named after the Neelakurunji flowers (purplish-blue flowers) found in the Shola forests of Nilgiri hills.
 
• Nilgiri Hills are known as the Blue Mountains.
 
 
 
• Palani hills- Palani hills is a range of mountains that lie in the states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
 
 
• The hill is an eastward extension of the Western Ghats, which aligns with the west coast of India.
 
 
 
• Annamalai hills- The highest hill is Annamalai, which has a height (2,695 meters).
 
 
• These hills are the joint place of the Eastern and Western Ghats and are oriented towards the northwest and south-East.
 
• It is also called Elephant Mountains.

questions.question: Which of the following is a war-related dance?
questions.solution:
• Chhau of Mayurbhanj is a war-related dance.
 
• It originated from the forests of Mayurbhanj(a district in Odisha) in the 18th century.

questions.question: Where is located the world's longest glass bridge that was opened for the public on December 24, 2017?
questions.solution:
World's longest glass bridge that was opened for the public on December 24, 2017, is located in Hebei, China.

 
• It is 488-meter long glass footpath.
 
• The bridge is designed to hold 3,000 people.

questions.question: Who among the following is a recipient of ﬁrst World Sanskrit Award?
questions.solution:

• World Sanskrit Award was instituted by the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR).

questions.question:
Ionic compounds _________.

I. have high boiling point

II. have high melting point

III. conduct electricity in solution
questions.solution:
Ionic compounds have a high boiling point, have a high melting point and conduct electricity in solution.

 
• The compounds which are made up of ions are called as ionic compounds.
 
• Atoms lose or gain electrons and develop a net positive or negative charge to form an ion.

questions.question: Who is the principal spokesman of the Lok Sabha?
questions.solution:
Speaker of Lok Sabha is the principal spokesman of the Lok Sabha.

 
• He/she is the presiding officer of the Lok Sabha who serves for a period of five years.
 
• He/she is chosen from among the members of the Lok Sabha.
 
• Sumitra Mahajan of the Bharatiya Janata Party is the current Lok Sabha Speaker.

questions.question: In India, the ﬁrst hour of every Parliamentary sitting is allotted for ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option __**1**__ i.e __**Question hour**__.

__
 
• In India, the **ﬁrst hour of every Parliamentary sitting is allotted for Question Hour**__.

 
 
• In this hour, the Members of the Parliament raise questions related to the activity of the Administration.
 
 

 
 

 
 
**Types Of Questions during Question Hour**

 
 
 
** Method of Answer**

 
 
 

 
 
 Starred

 
 
 
 Oral reply

 
 
 

 
 
 Non- starred

 
 
 
 Written reply

 
 
 

 
• **Zero hour**

 
 
• Zero Hour is a 30 minute's session wherein a member gets three minutes to raise the issue.
 
• Moreover, a member is allowed to make only one Zero Hour request during a week.
 
• Unlike the Question Hour, it is not mentioned in the Rules of Procedure.

questions.question: Who coined the term ‘protoplasm’ for the ﬂuid substance of the cell?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **J.E Purkinje**__ coined the term ‘__**protoplasm**__’ for the ﬂuid substance of the cell.
 
• He coined the term ‘protoplasm’ in 1839.
 
• The living content of a cell that is surrounded by a plasma membrane is called the Protoplasm.
 
• It is composed of a mixture of small molecules such as ions, amino acids, monosaccharides and water, and macromolecules such as nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, and polysaccharides.

questions.question: Under Aajeevika Grameen Express Yojana (AGEY) launched in Aug 2017, the beneﬁciary will be provided an interest-free loan up to ________ for the purchase of the vehicle.
questions.solution:
• Under Aajeevika Grameen Express Yojana (AGEY) launched in Aug 2017, the beneﬁciary will be provided an interest-free loan up to Rs 6.50 lakh for purchase of the vehicle.
 
• The Government of India launched this scheme as a part of the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM).
 
• Safe, affordable and community supervised rural transport services like e-rickshaws, 3 and 4 wheeler transport vehicles to connect remote villages, is the objective of this scheme.

questions.question: Scientists of which institute have found a way to induce points to give off dim light to plants by embedding luciferase enzyme?
questions.solution:
As of 2017, the Scientists of Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) have found a way to induce points to give off dim light to plants by embedding luciferase enzyme.

 
• The vision behind this invention was to make plants function as a desk lamp which is not powered by electricity but by the energy metabolism of the plant itself.

questions.question: In September 2017, RBI has capped bank investments in private equity fund at ________ percent of paid-up capital.
questions.solution:
• In September 2017, RBI has capped bank investments in private equity fund at 10 percent of paid-up capital.
 
• Under the guidelines issued by RBI, now the banking subsidiaries which make investments in private equity above 10% of the capital would have to look for the approval from the banking regulator.

questions.question: Due to an acceleration of 1 m/s² the velocity of a body increases from 15 m/s to 20 m/s in a certain period. Find the displacement (in m) of the body in that period.
questions.solution:
Due to an acceleration of 1 m/s2 the velocity of a body increases from 15 m/s to 20 m/s in a certain period. The displacement of the body in that period is 87.5 m.

Formula for displacement

s = ut + (1)/(2) a t² (Where u = initial velocity 15 m/s, a = acceleration 1m/s², time taken)

Formula for time

t = frac{{{{v}} - {{u}}}}{{{a}}} (where v = final velocity 20 m/s).

For finding time:

t = frac{{( {20 - 15} )}}{1} = 5 seconds

For finding displacement

S = 15 × 5 + (1)/(2){{}} × 1 × 5 × 5

= 87.5 m

questions.question: The boundaries of the plates of the earth's crust are the weak zones known as _________ zones.
questions.solution:
The boundaries of the plates of the earth's crust are the __**weak zones known as seismic zones.**__

 
• The boundaries of the earth's plate are weak zones. Here earthquakes are more likely to occur.

These weak zones are called seismic or fault zones.

 
• Seismic or fault zones of India: In India, most of the threatened areas are:
 
 
• Kashmir
 
• Western and central Himalayas
 
• The whole of North-East
 
• Rann of Kutch
 
• Indo-Gangetic Plain.
 
• Some areas of south India.

questions.question: ________ networks are connected by telephones, underwater cables and satellites.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Computer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A computer is an electronic device that manipulates information or data.
 
• It has the ability to store, retrieve, and process data.
 
• You may already know that you can use a computer to type documents, send an email, play games, and browse the Web.
 
• Electronic devices are components for controlling the flow of electrical currents for the purpose of information processing and system control.
 
• Examples include transistors and diodes
 
• Electronic devices are usually small and can be grouped together into packages called integrated circuits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hardware is any part of your computer that has a physical structure, such as the keyboard or mouse. It also includes all of the computer's internal parts.
 
• Software is any set of instructions that tells the hardware what to do and how to do it. Examples of software include web browsers, games, and word processors.
